in_hebrew.name: Iver
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Iver הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Norse words ‘Yggdrasil’ and ‘Ipor’, meaning ‘the protector of the divine tree’. In Norse mythology, Yggdrasil is the tree of life that connects all realms of existence.
